test_title: PYST 28 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 22 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting in a row facing south (not necessarily in the same order). P is to the immediate right of T. P is fifth to the right of U. S is fifth to the left of T. W is third to the right of S. Only two girls sit between Q and V. V is an immediate neighbour of P. Which girl is sitting to the immediate right of R?
solution:
**Given: **P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting in a row facing south (not necessarily in the same order).

1. P is fifth to the right of U.

2. P is to the immediate right of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48a1e3af65e714795d37ab48f8009e3d12490bb97f5c5e8eff90ccc0231a0556.png] 

3. S is fifth to the left of T.

The above statement cannot be satisfied in case I, so it is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60d9fbbd4f5b01e7a63f5665e10c9ed149cd7fc1e305e8a79724d6d4a1d18aa1.png] 

4. V is an immediate neighbour of P.

The above statement cannot be satisfied in case III, so it is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b79778ff35c41bcd4a525d12401b656d7e9d2bad51d94ffde7f5aee3be60632.png] 

5. W is third to the right of S.

6. Only two girls sit between Q and V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ccc9b85594a09d6572f2159da145f5c2a9768d58ff3a205d311c05687eb686d.png] 

R, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d856b15537ae02a4d7801e1a0f93a3fc05e8a02ef60164fcec17f2f20218127a.png] 

 

Thus, W is sitting to the immediate right of R.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
